reproducibility.summary_note: mathematics.json includes measured build duration and is excluded from byte-equality requirement

regressions.scope: Local selector, engine, HTTP wallet, UI logic and RGS contract regressions. Minimal DOM tests do not establish browser visuals or platform approval.

high_band_design.design: 18 bands of 250x; non-cap RTP shares decline by factor 4/5 per band; frequency targets use band midpoints

legacy_cap_tests.method: Real legacy app.js in a minimal DOM with virtual time and a local API double; actual current weighted cap books plus an engine-produced exact-cap boundary fixture. No visual/browser claim.
